children.translated_text: From whose five mouths the Vedas arose, coming to the number five and taking the forms of <s>Ṛg</s>, <s>Yajus</s>, and <s>Sāman</s>,
together with <s>Āyurveda</s> and the <s>Atharvaveda</s>, may the devotion of <s>Śrīkaṇāda</s> abide in that <s>Śambhu</s>.

children.text: āste vedaḥ pañcamo vedyakākhyo vettā kaścittasya nāste maheśāt
children.translated_text: There is a fifth Veda called <s>Vaidyaka</s> (medicine); no one is a knower of it apart from <s>Maheśa</s>.
From him <s>Dhātā</s> studied it, and from <s>Dhātā</s> <s>Turāṣāṭ</s>; having learned it from him, I am able to expound the <s>śāstra</s> (treatise).

children.text: sārdhatrikoṭyo nāḍhyo hi sthūlāḥ sūkṣmāśca dehinām
children.translated_text: For embodied beings there are indeed thirty-five million <s>nāḍīs</s> (channels), both gross and subtle;
they are attached to the <s>nābhi-kanda</s> (navel-bulb) and are situated crosswise, upward, and downward.
Among them, seventy-two thousand are declared to be gross.
In the body those excellent <s>dhamanīs</s> (arterial channels) carry the qualities of the five sense faculties.

children.text: tāsāṃ ca sūkmamuṣirāṇi śatāni sapta syustāni yairasakṛd annarasaṃ vahadbhiḥ
children.translated_text: Of these there are seven hundred subtle hollow passages; by these, which repeatedly carry the essence of food,

children.text: āpyāyyate vapuridaṃ hi nṛṇām īṣāmambhaḥ sravāhṇeriva āṃsanghuśataiḥ sasudraḥ ||
children.translated_text: this body of human beings is nourished, like the ocean by hundreds of streams flowing with water.
From the feet upward and likewise from the head, the entire spread of limbs is pervaded by this network, whose station is at the navel,

children.text: etanmūdaṅga ddvava cammaṃcayena naddha kāyaṃ nṛṇāramiha sirāśatasaptakena ||
children.translated_text: and here the human body is bound by the set of seven hundred <s>sirās</s> (veins), like a <s>mṛdaṅga</s> (drum) by a layer of hide.

children.text: śatasaptānā madhye casurāvakā viṃśatiḥ sphuṭāstāsāmū ekā parīkṣaṇoyā yṛā dakṣiṇakaracaraṇavinyastā ? 1 ? ||
children.translated_text: Among the seven hundred, twenty-four are clearly distinguished; of them one is to be examined, the one placed in the right hand and foot. [? 1 ?]

children.text: ātayarmo dehināṃ nābhideśe vāme vaktra tasya pucchaṃ ca yāmye
children.translated_text: At the navel-region of embodied beings, a [tortoise-like] arrangement is described: its mouth is on the left and its tail is to the south;

children.text: ūrdhve bhāge hastapādau ca vāmau tasyādhastāt saṃsthitau dākṣaiṇau tau ||
children.translated_text: in the upper part are the left hand and foot, and below it those two on the right are situated.
